title: If the sun went out, how long until you die?

lines.text: If the sun went out right now, how long would it take for you to die?
For eight minutes, nothing. Sunlight takes that long to reach you.
Then the sky goes black. Even the moon vanishes.
Does Earth fly off into space? Nope. Gravity's still there. You orbit a dead star.
Day one. Plants stop growing. You put on three jumpers.
Minus eighteen outside. The crops are dead. The shops are empty.
The oceans freeze over. The power grid fails. Your heating cuts out.
Minus forty. Your body can't keep up. You lie down for a nap, and never wake up.
You died. Comment what stupid shenanigans Gary should try tomorrow.
